message: Lead reviewed committed 14a550cf Server/Services/ClientService.fs and HubService.fs. Keep next work focused on making SQLite admission/correction the actual authenticated MCP ingress gate (end-to-end, including no selected device, missing capabilities, failed route-binding before Send, HTTP abort/timeout after possible Send, and exact late receipt). Specific review cautions: HubService currently tracker.Complete runs before TryRecordAgentClientTerminal; on a SQLite failure the MCP caller can see terminal success while persisted liveness remains unknown. Preserve committed receipt but document this ordering and test failed persistence/recovery; do not equate tracker success with liveness proof. Avoid stringly typed error-prefix matching of 'No matching admitted request' to classify expected no-witness responses: return a typed outcome. Keep conservative startup/rolling-upgrade fence for pre-witness in-flight 3.63 calls, source actor identity for cross-project notifications, remote jobs whose handle may outlive command. Prefer the SQLite transaction as single authoritative admission/correction serialization mechanism, with in-memory gate only an optimization (not a second independent condition). No review/merge until production path wired and crash tests pass.
